axes.evidence: All four Requirement blocks declare Target=wave-1. The recorded MCP mutation log adds or edits only those four new IDs; it does not mutate an existing 0.5.5 Requirement or another target.
Each Requirement uses Status=planned and Stability=draft. Types are respectively reliability, observability, performance, and migration, and validate_spec reports no errors.
All referenced existing BGSTAB Requirement IDs resolve. MIG-BGSTAB-001 has depends_on links to exactly REL-BGSTAB-006, OBS-BGSTAB-004, and PERF-BGSTAB-008.
Every cited local Code and Related Docs path exists, and every cited line-range endpoint is within the UTF-8 file's current line count.

The characterization requirements define machine-readable manifests/results, deterministic cases, hashes, raw samples, summary provenance, and explicit validation methods; G1 defines a machine-readable decision record and evaluator.

The 24/1,000/10,000 line values, legacy 2 MiB boundary, and benchmark session/client counts are explicitly constrained to characterization corpora. No retained-range, memory, checkpoint, SLO, or transport budget is selected.
MIG-BGSTAB-001 permits exactly confirmed-bug-only or architectural migration, rejects implicit/default third outcomes, and requires evidence for both selection and rejection.

The confirmed-bug-only branch is bounded to at most one separately identified reproduced-defect fix and keeps waves 2-5/#4-#22 inactive or deferred. Architectural migration requires a separate exact Requirement ID with Stability=stable before wave-2 activation.
The requirements explicitly do not authorize authority promotion, existing UI changes, legacy deletion, or future retained-state/product policy selection.

srs_delta records SpecKiwi MCP as the sole docs/spec mutation mechanism and contains add_requirement/add_trace_link/replace_acceptance_criteria calls limited to the four new IDs. validate_spec returned 0 errors; its four SRS-W023 warnings are the expected consequence of intentionally draft contracts and do not violate the normal CRITICAL/HIGH gate.

validation_observations.warning_disposition: Expected for the four intentionally draft requirements; feasibility/stability promotion is a later guarded phase and implementation remains blocked while draft.
